evidence_slice: University of Exeter’s public ArcGIS Roof Access Safety Web App states that the Digital Estate Team developed the dashboard for Exeter campuses, that it provides detailed building-specific roof data across Streatham and St Luke’s, and that the map includes interactive layers such as university rooftops. The same public item page states that the map incorporates licensed Ordnance Survey and other authoritative geographic data and restricts extraction/reuse. In this selected source window, no record-level feature service URL, polygon coordinate payload, or record-bound building identity/type-use fields were exposed; no geometry or classification was inferred, extracted from a screenshot, or spatially joined.

field_evidence.footprint: The official public dashboard states that building-specific roof data and university-rooftop layers exist across Exeter campuses, but the selected public item window exposes no record-level polygon coordinates.
field_evidence.type_use: The official application scope/tags distinguish academic, residential and non-residential buildings, but no record-bound type/use value was exposed for a specific polygon feature in this window.
